title.heading: Samvaad Charades
title.subheading: Real CAG audit pages. BHASHINI's machine draft. The CAG glossary. Prove your Hindi across five levels, win four titles and bank up to 50 credits.
title.voiceHelp: Hear Sahayak read each briefing aloud. Change it anytime in Settings.
title.tagline: The translation challenge for audit professionals.
title.perksHeading: Every level pays off: in credits, in rank, in skill.

perks.title: Up to 50 credits
perks.body: Your best score in each level converts to credits, recorded against your name for the Hindi Pakhwada awards.

perks.title: Four titles and a certificate
perks.body: Score 33 or more to win Anuvad Pathik, Nipun, Vidwan and Visheshagya, all on one certificate.

perks.title: A place on the leaderboard
perks.body: See where you stand in your office, your state and across the department.

perks.title: A skill you use every day
perks.body: Train on the same BHASHINI workbench and CAG glossary that power Anuvaad.

title.stepsHeading: Join in a minute. Play at your pace.

steps.title: Enlist
steps.body: Register with your official email and office. A one-time code confirms it's you.

steps.title: Warm up
steps.body: Open with the 300-word Trial, then take on the levels. Each gives you three chances.

steps.title: Climb
steps.body: Your best score in every level counts. Win titles, bank credits, climb the board.

title.footer: For officers of the Indian Audit & Accounts Department · Content: CAG Report No. 38 of 2025

howToPlay.heading: Training ground
howToPlay.headingEn: Learn the controls before your first mission

steps.title: Your mission
steps.body: Every level hands you a page from a real CAG audit report in English. Your job: deliver Hindi to CAG's published standard.

steps.title: How you score
steps.body: Your score out of 100 draws on five measures: translation quality, time, completion, glossary terms and sentence construction. Score 33 or more to win the level's title.

steps.title: Your toolkit
steps.body: Type in Roman letters and pick a Hindi suggestion, or use your device's Hindi keyboard. In the Trial you can also speak. Try it below.

steps.title: Your coach
steps.body: Sahayak is on hand in every level for hints, glossary terms and time checks, but never gives away the answer.

points: Built for officers of the Indian Audit & Accounts Department.
What you gain: appraisal benefit, real translation practice and Hindi Pakhwada credits.
Credits: Joining 2 · Trial 3 · Primary 5 · Secondary 15 · Professional 25 = 50
From Level 2, BHASHINI supplies a machine draft. Find its errors and fix them.
In the Trial (Level 1), you translate everything yourself.

Try the ways to write Hindi on the right.
howToPlay.practiceNote: Practice only. Nothing here is saved.

rules.heading: Rules of the game
rules.headingEn: Three rules keep the field fair
rules.rule1Body: During a mission, copy and paste are disabled. Leaving the page is counted and shown on your report card.
rules.rule2Body: Play each level up to three times. Only your best score counts, so a weaker run never costs you credits.
rules.rule3Body: Speak-to-type works only in the Trial. From Level 2 on, you type every word.

latin_word.en: replace English words with Hindi ones.
latin_word.hi: अंग्रेज़ी शब्दों की जगह हिंदी शब्द लिखिए।

missing_danda.en: end every sentence with a full stop (।).
missing_danda.hi: हर वाक्य के अंत में पूर्ण विराम (।) लगाइए।

vowel_sign_start.en: a word should not start with a vowel sign.
vowel_sign_start.hi: कोई शब्द मात्रा से शुरू नहीं होना चाहिए।

repeated_word.en: a word appears twice in a row.
repeated_word.hi: एक शब्द लगातार दो बार लिखा गया है।

unbalanced_bracket.hi: जो कोष्ठक ( ) खोला है, उसे बंद भी कीजिए।

number_missing.en: keep every number from the English page.
number_missing.hi: अंग्रेज़ी पेज का हर अंक अपने अनुवाद में रखिए।

refuseTranslate.en: Translating the page is your job in this mission. I can offer a hint or the right glossary term instead.
refuseTranslate.hi: इस मिशन में पेज का अनुवाद आपका काम है। इसके बजाय एक संकेत या सही शब्दावली शब्द यहाँ उपलब्ध है।
